problems.title: Batched Bernoulli logits can lose a representable tail and its gradient
problems.summary: At logit +40 and observation 1, subtracting softplus from the logit cancels the Float64 log mass. The native reverse gradient also loses its tail. A cached gradient must remain correct when later inputs change sign.

commits.title: Preserve Bernoulli-logit tails and gradients in native and compiled batches

problems.title: Bounded parameters need a flat density with the correct transform
problems.summary: A Stan parameter with a bound and no prior has constant density on its support. A normalized Uniform adds a parameter-dependent term when a bound depends on another parameter. An unconstrained Flat omits the support and Jacobian.

commits.title: Support truncated flat priors and parameter-dependent density bounds

fix.why_together: One cherry-pick supplies the distribution, Plaice transform, support and Jacobian regressions. The traced density is covered separately from the complete compiled model, whose transform depends on Plaice.

validation.detail: PR #203 reported 29/29 on this component revision. A complete Reactant model with dynamic bounds remains limited by the Plaice transform.

problems.title: Benchmarking can change an explicitly supplied vector
problems.summary: Converting a start through model space before building a VecModel can change the vector used for density and gradient timing. The effect is visible with simplex parameters, even when the requested unconstrained coordinates are all zero.

commits.title: Benchmark models at their exact vector start

fix.why_together: One cherry-pick preserves the start, supports benchmarking a prepared VecModel, and includes docs and seeded cross-backend regression tests.

draft.title: benchmark_model changes an explicitly supplied unconstrained starting vector
draft.body:
On Wren main at `68932e0089ab07ff47153a591a48a3f3990d63e2`, the model-level benchmark obtains original-space parameters and then vectorises them again. On a simplex, that round trip can change individual coordinates of a start the caller already supplied in unconstrained space.

```julia
using WrenCore
import WrenDists

@wren function simplex_prior()
    x ~ WrenDists.Dirichlet(fill(0.1, 1495))
end

start = zeros(1494)
source = FromValues(VarNamedTuple(x=TransformedValue(start, AsUnconstrainedVec())))
r = benchmark_model(simplex_prior(); latent_source=source, verbose=false, seconds=0.01)
@show maximum(abs.(r.vecmodel.sample .- start))
@assert r.vecmodel.sample == start
```

Expected: the benchmark evaluates the density and gradient at the exact supplied vector, including when the caller compares AD backends. Taking the vector directly also avoids applying the model-to-vector simplex transform a second time. The separate sparse-prior-draw failure is tracked in #202.
